messages:
anya: Heads-up — planning a staged enable of feature flags kb_prefetch_v2 + microbatch_coalesce for hosted inference tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Goal: lower p95 and unit token cost. Quick safety checklist and who can be oncall?
kevin: timeline works for me. Are we doing 5%->25%->80% or region-limited canary? What are clear rollback triggers?
anya: plan is us-west1 only, stages 5% -> 25% -> 80% over ~3 hours. Rollback if p99 increases >100ms absolute or error rate +0.5% absolute. Abort on throughput drop >10%.
micah: please add KV cache hit rate and eviction rate to the triggers. If kv_hit drops >5 percentage points we should roll back.
zarah: can someone add a temporary panel in eng-runtime/caches for kv_hit_delta and kv_evictions? Quick link helps on-call.
anya: added temp panels and pinned to the rollout dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.io/d/rollout/kb-prefetch (will DM exact link).
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by anya for 2026-03-18T17:00Z on canary us-west1. Rollout job #R-4521 queued.
kevin: preflight checklist: 1) smoke on staging, 2) 2h soak on canary-lb, 3) perf job 'batch_sim' with sample corpus. I ran smoke locally, all good.
kevin: flag config snippet:
```
flag: kb_prefetch_v2
audience: region=us-west1
stages: [5,25,80]
kill-switch: true
metrics: [latency_p99, error_rate, kv_hit_rate]
```
micah: I'll run the load test at 09:30 PT and post results. @sre-oncall please stay alerted for the window.
sre-oncall: I'm on the rota. Alerts set: latency_p99 > baseline + 100ms, errors > 0.5% absolute, kv_evictions > 2% absolute.
zarah: note: microbatch_coalesce can surface tail queueing with high per-worker concurrency. Keep per-worker concurrency cap at 8 during rollout.
anya: acknowledged — we'll lock concurrency cap to 8 and enable 1% debug log sampling for prefetched ops.
kevin: rollback steps (documenting): 1) flip kb_prefetch_v2 off, 2) flip microbatch_coalesce off, 3) revert canary routing, 4) run infra job clear-prefetch to evict stale state (/infra/jobs/clear-prefetch R-101).
micah: small add: after rollback, re-run canary twice (two short steady-state runs) to confirm no downstream latent issues before full revert.
anya: tagging eng-reviews for PR #2345 — @kevin please ping if anything blocks merge.
kevin: PR merged, CI green. :thumbsup:
anya: ok we proceed tomorrow. I'll post a 30m reminder and then start the rollout.
deploy-bot: rollout started: stage 1 (5%) started. Monitoring hooks enabled.
deploy-bot: stage 1 (5%) complete — no anomalies in first 10m.
micah: quick load test summary: p50 -12%, p95 -8%, p99 +20ms (within threshold), KV hit +3ppt. Posting full logs to the perf bucket.
zarah: infra metrics show no error spike, queue depth stable. Good to go to 25%.
anya: starting stage 2 (25%).
deploy-bot: stage 2 (25%) complete. Observed kv_eviction +1.2% (within tolerance). No alert.
micah: running longer perf sweep now.
kevin: proceeding to 80% per plan.
deploy-bot: stage 3 (80%) complete. No alerts triggered. Will auto-promote to 100% in 30m unless we see drift.
sre-oncall: I will monitor for the next hour and escalate on any p99 or error anomalies.
anya: final: opening post-rollout ticket with consolidated perf numbers and follow-ups (including potential microbatch tuning). Thanks team!
